review.head: e43a9fef39aa6b8862b1e45b18984e2e8394ba5b
review.notes: Full review. Gate: FAIL on build=1 (module-system warning), every other counter 0; depcheck 0 problems as-is and with *Needs:* substituted for *Prerequisites:* (1526/1531 edges, no UPWARD/CYCLE); no open roadmap cites SiegelModularForms as a supplier. Seeded sample (2.1, 2.3, 2.4, 3.3, 5.1, 5.4, 6.5, 7.2, 7.5, 8.3, 8.5, 9.5, 9.8, 10.4, 11.4) checked against van der Geer arXiv:math/0605346 (Def 4.1, Thms 4.3-4.4, Cor 4.2/4.5, Prop 4.6, Thm 5.4, Cor 5.5, Thm 6.2, Thm 9.1, Lemma 16.1, Prop 16.2, Thm 16.3, Defs 16.4-16.5, Thm 17.1, Prop 18.1, section 20, Thm 21.1, Conj 21.3, section 25 table), Poor-Yuen arXiv:0912.0049 (Thms 1.2, 1.3, 3.1, Table 1, 277 Euler factors), Brumer-Kramer arXiv:1004.4699 (Conj 1.1, Conj 8.2), BPPTVY arXiv:1805.10873, CCG arXiv:1906.10939; Andrianov 1974, Roberts-Schmidt 2007, Arakawa, Satoh, Cohen, Kohnen, Igusa, Tsushima, Ikeda, Boecherer not readable legally (uncertified or landing pages only). Adversarial table of 46 rows with computed values (Cohen H values, Eisenstein and Igusa coefficients recomputed from generalized Bernoulli numbers, Satake/eigenvalue identities, Hecke coset degrees, Hilbert series, dimension tables, 277 point count). Three P1: gate build failure; the Lean parity lemma eq_zero_of_neg_one_mem is false for reducible weights (det^0 + det^1, f = (1,0)); the 8.3 holomorphy clause for the standard L-function (rank 2g) is refuted by the roadmap's own Ikeda lift I(Delta) in S_8(Gamma_4) (source error in van der Geer, section 20). Three P2: 9.8's parity hypothesis excludes the Miyawaki instance (van der Geer Conj 21.3 misprint); sorry inside three theorem statements; the Saito-Kurokawa headline is statable at the pins (probe elaborated) but absent. Seven P3: wrong branch example in 5.2, wrong discriminant exponent in 11.2, supplier/deferral drift (ShimuraCompactifications C4-C5, LatticePackings Layer 8 D16+, HalfIntegralWeightModularForms not owning half-integral Siegel forms, CCG misattribution, unnamed character/abelian-variety roadmaps, Tau Ceti theta modules not at the pin), README not in house shape (no *Needs:* lines, no Examples/Dependencies, most definitions without Checks, local path in references), padding in Suggested.lean (five one-tactic closures confirmed), the L(k,f) nonvanishing remark, the Kohnen exponent gloss.
